To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

belief is a KD45 operator, belief change can be modeled using conditioning and prior plausibilities (which is a generalization of prior probabilities), and that belief revision and belief updating are special cases of this general framework.
belief can be characterized as a KD45 operator, and belief change can be characterized as conditioning on a prior plausibility.

(1) Belief is the KD45 operator that results when we require that knowledge is more plausible than plausibility, (2) Belief revision can be modeled by conditioning on the old plausibility measure, and (3) Belief update can be modeled by updating the old plausiblity measure.
